capabilities: Number paragraphs with inline [N] verse markers
Link, range, and disjoint-reference verses via wiki-links
Preview verse text in hover popovers
Embed cited verses inline as native-style cards
Group verses into sections and copy verse references or deep-link via URI
extras: Docs include a collision warning for the opt-in shorthand syntax ([[File#3]] can hijack links to headings literally named "3"), which is why it ships off by default.
motivation: The author originally built it for study notes over scripture, then generalized it to any text needing stable per-paragraph anchors.
problem: Obsidian's links and embeds only resolve real headings or blocks, so fine-grained, stable per-paragraph anchors like Bible verses cannot be cited or transcluded.
summary: Inline verse numbering plugin that turns [N] tokens into stable, anchorable verse targets you can link, hover-preview, and embed across the vault.
